content:
Last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, Apple TV unveiled a number of announcements, including the premiere date for the fourth season of "Silo".

"Silo" season 4 will debut in the summer of 2027 and will serve as the show's final season.

Season 3 of "Silo" is currently airing (available here), with new episodes dropping weekly until September 4.

However, beyond news of other sci-fi series at San Diego Comic-Con last weekend, Apple had a surprise in store for "Silo" fans.

"Silo" season 4 will return next summer, bringing the entire series to a close.

Below is the announcement post Apple TV shared on X:

In the streaming era, it's become commonplace for new seasons of shows to return after multi-year gaps, and this is especially true for high-budget sci-fi series like "Silo".

Nevertheless, Apple has been proactive in renewing certain shows early to speed up their return. Seasons 3 and 4 of "Silo" were greenlit simultaneously and filmed back-to-back.

"Silo" still has six more weeks of new episodes to air, but once this season wraps, the wait for season 4 won't be too long.

What are your thoughts on "Silo" season 3? Feel free to share them in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and discounts are also available through Apple One bundles.
